mapper.insert: INSERT INTO card_transaction( card_id, transacted_at, merchant_name, amount, installment, category_id, memo ) VALUES ( #{cardId}, #{transactedAt}, #{merchantName}, #{amount}, #{installment}, #{categoryId}, #{memo} )
mapper.select: SELECT transaction_id, card_id, transacted_at, merchant_name, amount, installment, category_id, memo, created_at FROM card_transaction WHERE card_id = #{cardId} ORDER BY transacted_at DESC, transaction_id DESC LIMIT #{cri.pageSize} OFFSET #{cri.offset}

SELECT transaction_id, card_id, transacted_at, merchant_name, amount, installment, category_id, memo, created_at FROM card_transaction WHERE card_id = #{cardId} ORDER BY transacted_at DESC, transaction_id DESC

SELECT transaction_id, card_id, transacted_at, merchant_name, amount, installment, category_id, memo, created_at FROM card_transaction WHERE card_id = #{cardId} AND DATE(transacted_at) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY transacted_at DESC, transaction_id DESC LIMIT #{cri.pageSize} OFFSET #{cri.offset}

SELECT ct.transaction_id, ct.card_id, ct.transacted_at, ct.merchant_name, ct.amount, ct.installment, ct.category_id, ct.memo, ct.created_at FROM card_transaction ct JOIN card c ON ct.card_id = c.card_id WHERE c.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY ct.transacted_at DESC, ct.transaction_id DESC
LIMIT #{limit}
